passage: Throughout history, scientific discoveries have often challenged established beliefs. When astronomers first proposed that Earth revolved around the sun, many people rejected the idea because it contradicted traditional assumptions. Similarly, advances in medicine and biology have repeatedly forced societies to reconsider long-held views about health and human behavior. Although scientific progress can create controversy, it also encourages critical thinking and expands human understanding. By questioning accepted ideas, scientists contribute to intellectual growth and innovation.
